title: The Tribeca Glasshouse Penthouse
description: A complete architectural gut and structural reimagining of a historic duplex penthouse. Featuring double-height travertine fireplace monolithic walls, custom curved bouclé millwork, and seamless indoor-outdoor terrace integration with bespoke bronze glazing.
testimonial: “Atelier Aura turned an overwhelming penthouse overhaul into an effortless, transparent masterclass in construction and haute design.” — M. Sterling, Owner

title: Bel-Air Architectural Sanctuary
description: Ground-up architectural construction merging raw board-formed architectural concrete, warm western red cedar overhangs, and cantilevered living pavilions overlooking the Pacific horizon.
testimonial: “The level of structural precision and site supervision was unparalleled. Delivered on schedule with zero compromise.” — D. K., Principal

title: Kensington Private Kitchen & Suite
description: Haute culinary architecture featuring a monolithic 4.2-meter Calacatta Viola island, concealed fluted walnut joinery, integrated Gaggenau 400 series appliances, and handcrafted lime plaster walls.
scope: Load-bearing wall removal & steel beam placement
testimonial: “A kitchen that feels like an art gallery yet functions like a Michelin-starred workstation.” — Lord & Lady H.

title: SoHo Flagship Creative Studio
description: Adaptive reuse of a cast-iron historic loft into a multi-disciplinary design atelier. Microcement continuous flooring, minimalist black steel partitions, and acoustically damped client presentation suites.
testimonial: “Our team and high-profile clients are in awe every single day. The space elevated our brand instantly.” — Agency CEO

title: Cotswolds Spa Pavilion & Bath
description: A private wellness retreat featuring a monolithic carved limestone soaking tub, frameless fluted glass rainfall shower with skylight, and radiant heated stone slabs.
testimonial: “The tranquility and tactile warmth of this sanctuary exceeded all our dreams.” — C. Davenport

title: Greenwich Modern Heritage Estate
description: Suburban estate transformed from a dated 1980s compartmentalized floorplan into an expansive Japandi architectural residence with seamless cross-ventilation and natural daylighting.
scope: Full turnkey general contracting and handover
testimonial: “From 3D plans to final key handover, Atelier Aura managed every subcontractor with surgical accuracy.” — E. & R. Miller
